- **Topics your repo carries** (honest list, e.g. `agent-skills`, `dsh-plugin`):

## Checklist

- [ ] Repo is public and works from a clean install of the install line above
- [ ] Skill names are kebab-case and descriptions describe *when to use* them
- [ ] No misleading tags; one entry per repo

By submitting you confirm the payload is yours or MIT/Apache-2 compatible.
